cases.title: Visible help beside the editor
cases.statement: In this fictional scenario, hover-only help was rejected because it was hard to find.
cases.next_action: Keep essential help beside the control, then check it in the actual narrow layout.
cases.limits: A synthetic example, not real feedback or a universal ban on tooltips.
evidence: Synthetic scenario authored for this public example; no external receipt.
